operations.summary: Messaging analytics (sent/delivered) on the WABA node
operations.approval: none: read-only bounded analytics read with redacted output
operations.description: Messaging analytics ledger row on the WABA node. Graph accepts the start/end/granularity filters only as a field expansion (fields=analytics.start(..).end(..).granularity(..)), which the declarative direct-read engine cannot author without a raw Graph `fields` flag, so no CLI command binds this operation and `analytics messaging` is declared unsupported_api.

operations.approval: none: read-only bounded template analytics with connector-authored query parameters and redacted output
operations.description: Bounded template analytics read-query over the template_analytics edge, which takes flat query parameters; connector-authored flags map to the time window, granularity, template ids, and metric types. No raw Graph fields string is exposed.

operations.summary: Bounded typed multipart media upload (executable via the upload_media reverse-ETL action)
operations.approval: reverse ETL plan, preview, approval, execute; bounded local file path only
operations.description: Typed WhatsApp media upload; executable through the upload_media write action. Only a declared local file path field is accepted; no generic upload flag is exposed.

operations.summary: Bounded media download from a 5-minute TTL media URL
operations.approval: filesystem writes require an explicit bounded destination policy
operations.description: Downloads WhatsApp media bytes (patient content; PHI) from the resolved media URL with a bounded max size and no overwrite by default.

operations.approval: web mode requires a local QR session; modeled from whatsapp-cli, not executed by the HTTP engine
operations.description: WhatsApp Web multidevice continuous sync into a local store; patient content is PHI.
